notes.title: HOTFIX!
notes.notes:
We've just released a hotfix for No Customers Left addressing the majority of bugs reported since launch. We sincerely apologize to anyone who encountered issues during their experience — your feedback has been invaluable, and we truly appreciate your support. 

Please continue to report any bugs you find so we can keep improving the game. 



Thank you for playing and sticking with us!
